name: Scent of Love
source:
Riley is your average teenage girl... or at least that's what she thought. One day she meets... a talking skunk?! Riley agrees to help it, and her life changes. Maybe her love life as well... Wait, love... with a skunk?! What even is this game? How does this story go? That depends on you and your choices.

[From [url=https://crystal-birds-studio.itch.io/scent-of-love]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
莱利是一个普通的十几岁女孩……或者至少她是这么认为的。有一天她遇到了……一只会说话的臭鼬？！莱利同意提供帮助，她的生活发生了变化。也许她的爱情生活也是如此……等等，爱情……和一只臭鼬？！这到底是什么游戏？这个故事进展如何？这取决于你和你的选择。

[来自[url=https://crystal-birds-studio.itch.io/scent-of-love]itch.io[/url]]
